_comment: Ground truth written by hand from the PDF. gold_pages = physical PDF pages that contain the answer. evidence = strings a retrieved chunk must ALL contain to count as holding the answer (retrieval eval). answer_keywords = list of groups; an answer is correct when every group has at least one alternative in it (Hindi and English spellings, case/space-insensitive). expected_answer is a human reference only; the system never sees any of this.
